```{r setup, include=FALSE}

# load libraries
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)

```

## Load Data

Load barcode count matrix
```{r load_data}

ec_data = read.csv("ec_manuscript_data.csv", row.names = 1)


```

Load HBMAP results
```{r mcmc_unique}

mcmc_unique_EC8 = readRDS("ec_hbmap_results.rds")

```

Extract Motif Allocations, and add to barcode count matrix as new column.
```{r}

EC8_Z_reordered = mcmc_unique_EC8$Z

ec_data$allocation = unlist(EC8_Z_reordered)

```

## Generate Plot

```{r}

nc_targets = c("PFC","ORB", "MO", "SS", "ACA", "PTL", "VIS", "RSC")

```

```{r motif_heatmap_function}

motif_group_heatmaps = function(data, motif_group, targets, high_col){
  
  # create motif dataframe
  motif_data = data %>% filter(allocation %in% motif_group)
  
  # filter for targets
  target_data = motif_data %>% select(allocation, all_of(targets))
  
  # get per-motif regional barcode count sums
  motif_data_sums = target_data %>% group_by(allocation) %>%
                          summarise(across(targets, sum, na.rm = TRUE))
  
  # row-sum normalize the sum data
  target_sums = motif_data_sums %>% select(all_of(targets))
  motif_data_sum_norm = as.data.frame(t((apply(target_sums, 1, function(x) (x / sum(x))))))
  
  # re-attach metadata
  motif_data_sum_norm$allocation = motif_data_sums$allocation
  
  
  # convert to long format
  motif_data_sum_norm_long = motif_data_sum_norm %>% pivot_longer(-allocation,
                                                                          names_to = "region",
                                                                          values_to = "proj_str")
  
  # define order of regions on the x-axis
  motif_data_sum_norm_long$region = factor(motif_data_sum_norm_long$region,
                                          levels = targets)

  # define motif allocations as groups, rather than a continous numerical axis
  motif_data_sum_norm_long$allocation = factor(motif_data_sum_norm_long$allocation,
                                                  levels = motif_group)
  
  # generate ggplot
  ggplot(motif_data_sum_norm_long, aes(region, allocation, fill= proj_str)) + 
    geom_tile() +
    scale_fill_gradient(low="white", high= high_col, limits = c(0, 1)) + theme_minimal()
  
}



```

```{r}

all_motifs = c(5, 1, 6, 13, 55, 4, 56, 24, 23, 33, 40, 64, 26, 25, 61)

motif_group_heatmaps(ec_data, all_motifs, nc_targets, "blue")

```
